"""Independent source gate; focused CPU fakes do not establish native CUDA behavior."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast

ROOT = Path("/Users/teilomillet/Code/wyat")
RESULT = ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/cuda-shape-source-review.json"
FILES = (
    "benchmarks/analysis/cuda/shape/__init__.py",
    "benchmarks/analysis/cuda/shape/run.py",
    "benchmarks/analysis/cuda/shape/study.py",
    "tests/analysis/test_cuda_shape.py",
    "docs/analysis/shape.md",
)
TRANSPORT = Path("/private/tmp/wyat-cuda-shape-transport.py")
PRIOR = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/engine-cuda-latency-verification.json"


def sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def obj(value: object) -> dict[str, object]:
    assert isinstance(value, dict)
    return cast(dict[str, object], value)


def read(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    return obj(json.loads(path.read_bytes()))


def run(args: list[str], cap: int) -> dict[str, object]:
    start = time.monotonic()
    child = subprocess.Popen(
        args,
        cwd=ROOT,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
        start_new_session=True,
    )
    timed_out = False
    try:
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=cap)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        try:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
        stdout, stderr = child.communicate()
    return dict(
        command=args,
        exit_code=child.returncode,
        timed_out=timed_out,
        reaped=child.poll() is not None,
        cap_seconds=cap,
        elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - start,
        stdout=stdout,
        stderr=stderr,
    )


def main() -> None:
    assert not RESULT.exists()
    before = {name: sha(ROOT / name) for name in FILES}
    assert (
        before["tests/analysis/test_cuda_shape.py"]
        == "86a6d5dbc6562e6622b3b3abb537c8c4e1efd44d47b1192aa950af8207a774f6"
    )
    assert (
        before["benchmarks/analysis/cuda/shape/study.py"]
        == "e11b1d1eb8362e9ce0bd50f12d13adab7ccbf815edeccf0a8ae49a40651cb16e"
    )
    assert (
        sha(TRANSPORT)
        == "c704af3f1f8e75a8394575478feb98ba61362969d20e695267ada3483d79dd37"
    )
    assert (
        sha(PRIOR) == "67930b46739fdd3f35fbc00c425bdee3879c2008dc3a3ee57c51ae1893bc7cdf"
    )
    declaration = (
        ROOT / "benchmarks/analysis/results/cuda-shape-source-declaration-20261005.json"
    )
    assert (
        sha(declaration)
        == "16067a59ecebe08ff86fb6e101f8af568dd96d16a49bc6f62e4ad1aee31db79b"
    )
    assert read(declaration) == before
    previous = read(PRIOR)
    old = obj(previous["source_sha256"])
    assert len(old) == 133 and all(
        sha(ROOT / name) == checksum for name, checksum in old.items()
    )
    production = [name for name in old if name.startswith("wyat/")]
    assert len(production) == 20
    python_files = [name for name in FILES if name.endswith(".py")]
    checks = {
        "pytest": run(
            [
                str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/pytest"),
                "-q",
                "-rs",
                "tests/analysis/test_cuda_shape.py",
            ],
            120,
        ),
        "mypy": run(
            [str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/mypy"), "--strict", *python_files, str(TRANSPORT)],
            120,
        ),
        "ruff": run(
            [str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/ruff"), "check", *python_files, str(TRANSPORT)], 60
        ),
        "format": run(
            [
                str(ROOT / ".venv/bin/ruff"),
                "format",
                "--check",
                *python_files,
                str(TRANSPORT),
            ],
            60,
        ),
        "stdlib_parent_help": run(
            [
                sys.executable,
                "-S",
                "-m",
                "benchmarks.analysis.cuda.shape.run",
                "--help",
            ],
            60,
        ),
    }
    after = {name: sha(ROOT / name) for name in FILES}
    assert before == after and all(
        sha(ROOT / name) == checksum for name, checksum in old.items()
    )
    assert (
        sha(TRANSPORT)
        == "c704af3f1f8e75a8394575478feb98ba61362969d20e695267ada3483d79dd37"
    )
    assert all(
        item["exit_code"] == 0 and item["timed_out"] is False and item["reaped"] is True
        for item in checks.values()
    )
    source = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
    source_sha = hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()
    archive = RESULT.with_suffix(f".audit-{source_sha[:16]}.txt")
    with archive.open("xb") as target:
        target.write(source)
    result = dict(
        passed=True,
        captured_utc=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        source_sha256=before,
        checks=checks,
        old_python_sources_unchanged=133,
        production_files_unchanged=20,
        artifact_sha256={
            str(PRIOR): sha(PRIOR),
            str(TRANSPORT): sha(TRANSPORT),
            str(declaration): sha(declaration),
            str(declaration): sha(declaration),
        },
        source_count=137,
        audit_script=dict(path=str(archive), sha256=source_sha, text=source.decode()),
        frameworks_imported=[
            name
            for name in ("torch", "transformers", "mlx", "numpy")
            if name in sys.modules
        ],
        review_findings_resolved=[
            "Raw Chrome export/hash/bytes only; actual schema interpretation deferred.",
            (
                "Exact shape association provenance admitted; prior "
                "input/control/screen/confirmation/timing source pins "
                "retained."
            ),
            (
                "Math28 comparator and reviewed efficient28 dispatch remain "
                "strict; no policy or numerical gate relaxation."
            ),
            (
                "Twelve pending outcomes seeded before admission; retained "
                "partial rows/export/cleanup failures and finite timing "
                "checks."
            ),
            (
                "Phase and worker wall values separate from call/body "
                "intervals; context exit precedes native export."
            ),
            (
                "Empty native export remains negative; final twelve ordered "
                "outputs/four profiles/raw byte identities/source checks "
                "required."
            ),
            (
                "Eight-file transfer whitelist, two exact historyreview "
                "hashes, exclusive source paths, bounded reaped groups and "
                "archive/trace no-symlink guards."
            ),
            "Timeout/kill race repaired in new helper; old helper/archive unchanged.",
            (
                "Nonuniform equal geometry distributions retain "
                "layer-permutation uncertainty; no "
                "causal/clock-domain/precision inference."
            ),
        ],
        limits=[
            (
                "Focused49 CPU-only fake tests establish lifecycle/contract "
                "behavior, not native CUDA quality, launch geometry, speed or "
                "actual trace schema."
            ),
            (
                "Full137/nativeCPU/Metal/DMBench regression owned separately "
                "by root; not inferred from this source gate."
            ),
            "No model, native CUDA capture or network execution occurred in this gate.",
        ],
    )
    assert result["frameworks_imported"] == []
    with RESULT.open("x") as target:
        json.dump(result, target, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        target.write("\n")
    print(
        json.dumps(
            dict(
                path=str(RESULT),
                sha256=sha(RESULT),
                checks={
                    k: {
                        x: v[x]
                        for x in ("exit_code", "timed_out", "reaped", "elapsed_seconds")
                    }
                    for k, v in checks.items()
                },
                source_sha256=source_sha,
            )
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
